text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a customer YAML that silently changes route behavior because of a header transform earlier in the chain. Thinking we need a lint rule + small console hint. Example:

alex: ```yaml
- match: /api/*
  headers: { X-Env: prod }
  transform_headers: { X-Env: staging }
  target: service-v2
- match: /api/*
  headers: { X-Env: staging }
  target: service-v1
```

alex: In that case the transform on the first rule makes it look like it should route to v1 but it actually rewrites upstream and causes the second rule to match at runtime — super surprising.

marta: ugh yeah. We’ve had shadowing bugs like this for path/host collisions. New thing here is transform order. Should we treat transforms as part of match-time semantics or strictly post-match?

chris: technically we perform header transforms after route selection today, so that YAML is valid but surprising. My vote: detect when transform makes a header equal to a value used by another active matcher and warn.

sam_pm: UX: console should surface a non-blocking warning inline next to the rule + give a quick action: "Simulate evaluation" that runs the canonicalizer against a sample request. Product-wise we can't block users, but we should make it obvious.

devex_bot: Suggestion: add static analysis that computes a "match footprint" for each rule: set of header keys/values the rule reads and writes. Then flag overlaps where writes -> read of another rule.

alex: I like that. For the lint rule we can implement two levels: warn (possible overlap) and error (definite overlap when static values match). Need test cases.

chris: Test cases idea: generate permutations where transform value is literal, templated, or from secret; only flag literals as error. Example literals should yield deterministic overlap.

samir: Also think about quotas & telemetry: if a transformed header causes traffic to fall into a lower quota bucket, customers will be surprised. We should add a metric "route.shadowed_evals" and a telemetry tag for "transform-affects-match:true" so SRE can alert.

marta: Good call. For console we can also add a small timeline trace that says "rule X evaluated, then route chosen Y" in the request inspector. Low effort if we can reuse existing tracing hooks.

alex: Implementation plan: 1) lint rule in authoring pipeline (CI + console preflight) 2) small console hint with quick-simulate 3) add telemetry counter + CI test harness. I can prototype the linter on Friday.

chris: If you want I can PR a few unit tests for the canonicalizer to ensure transforms are flagged. Will sync with you after prototype.

sam_pm: Awesome. If we add the telemetry tag, ops can create an alert for sudden increases. Assign owners?

alex: I'll own the lint + console hint. Chris owns the canonicalizer tests. Samir will do telemetry schema. Marta will spec UI copy.

deploy-bot: build 5078 passed (eng-platform/route-lint) :party-parrot:

marta: Thanks all — will add a short write-up in the authoring docs with examples and the quick-simulate UX mock. :thumbsup:
